newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia posts 600.7 mln trade surplus in August.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia posts 600.7 mln trade surplus in August.

text.p: Malaysia recorded a trade surplus of 600.7 million ringgit in August 1996 against a revised deficit of 614.97 million in July 1996 and a deficit of 1.14 billion ringgit deficit in August 1995, the Statistics Department said on Wednesday.

The department said that for the first eight months of this year, Malaysia recorded a smaller trade deficit of 835.48 million compared to a deficit of 8.05 billion ringgit in the first eight months of 1995, the national Bernama news agency reported.
The department added that the reduced trade deficit was a result of higher export growth to 129.58 billion ringgit while imports totalled 130.42 billion ringgit in the eight months.
The department said that in the January-August 1995 period, exports totalled 117.65 billion ringgit while imports amounted to 125.70 billion ringgit.
